briefing.headline: Soft landing stays on track as unemployment tightens and inflation eases toward target.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.56 percent for Sep 2026 is cooling steadily toward the Fed's target.
Unemployment fell to 4.1 percent in Oct 2026, keeping households confident enough to sustain spending.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury rose, from 4.98 percent to 5.1 percent.
